description: Run a PDN (power delivery network) impedance analysis: interplanar plane-pair capacitance, multi-cap decoupling impedance vs. target impedance, violations, and recommended decoupling caps. Reuses the Phase-25 engine behind POST /api/pdn/analyze. Inputs are derived server-side from the solved stackup, the BOM's PDN passives, and the power-tree rail — call with no arguments once a design exists.

decoupling_caps.description: Optional. Decoupling capacitors. Derived from the BOM's PDN passive lines when omitted.

plane_pairs.description: Optional. Power/ground plane pairs. Derived from the solved stackup when omitted.

target.description: Optional target-impedance config {voltage_v, ripple_pct, transient_current_a, rise_time_ns} or {preset_name}. Derived from the power-tree rail when omitted.

user_request.description: The end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. Used to verify that the figures you pass were stated by your user rather than inferred. Omit it and the results will be labelled caller-asserted.

name: run_pdn_analysis
title: Run power-delivery analysis
